description: Load a saved 2x2 dashboard containing `2D Network`, `Map`, `Bubble`, and `Table`, then drive one real vertical splitter drag and one real horizontal splitter drag.
primary_assertions: All four panes render at once; pane rects change after splitter drags; `2D Network`, `Map`, `Bubble`, and `Table` remain interactive after resize.
notes: Uses a committed `.microbetrace` fixture so layout mechanics stay deterministic.

description: Close a dashboard tab from the saved multi-pane layout, reopen it through the view menu, and verify sibling panes remain healthy.
primary_assertions: Homepage tabs stay aligned with Golden Layout state; reopened pane hydrates correctly; sibling panes do not blank or lose interactivity.
notes: Covered in the same saved-layout Golden Layout mechanics spec as DB001.

subarea: Hide show and resize lifecycle for data-table views
description: Load a saved dashboard containing `2D Network`, `Table`, `Aggregate`, `Crosstab`, and `Waterfall`, then emit Golden Layout `resize`, `hide`, and `show` events.
primary_assertions: `Table`, `Aggregate`, `Crosstab`, and `Waterfall` keep nonblank rendered state; widths and scroll heights recompute; Waterfall drilldown survives lifecycle changes.
notes: Uses a dedicated saved dashboard fixture with multiple tab stacks and table-driven views.

subarea: Global styling propagation across open views
description: Open the covered dashboard views on uploaded data and drive root Global Settings node-color and link-color changes.
primary_assertions: Fixed and categorical node-color changes update `2D Network`, `Map`, and `Bubble`; fixed and categorical link-color changes update `2D Network` and `Map`; non-style views keep dataset state stable.
notes: The maintained dashboard styling journey also guards against runtime banners and stuck processing modals.

description: Keep `2D Network`, `Map`, `Bubble`, `Table`, `Aggregate`, `Crosstab`, and `Waterfall` open in the dashboard, then change link threshold, Minimum Cluster Size, and Reveal Everything from root Global Settings.
primary_assertions: Each open pane refreshes to the intended filtered dataset for that view; Table row totals, Aggregate rows, Crosstab totals, and Waterfall drilldown stay coherent while the global graph changes.
notes: This is the dashboard filtering contract for the first tranche.

file_types: uploaded node + link with date field
description: Drive a deterministic dashboard timeline checkpoint and verify only the timeline-target views change visible membership.
primary_assertions: `2D Network`, `Map`, and `Bubble` follow the checkpoint while `Aggregate`, `Crosstab`, and `Waterfall` stay on the non-timeline filtered dataset; Waterfall drilldown is preserved.
notes: Table is intentionally excluded from first-pass dashboard timeline assertions until its cross-view timeline contract is documented.

description: Save a custom multi-pane dashboard layout and reload the `.microbetrace` file to prove the dashboard round-trips as a dashboard rather than only as a generic session.
primary_assertions: Restored tabs, active pane, and splitter arrangement should match the saved session; reopened panes should hydrate without manual tab re-entry.
fixture_gap: Need a dedicated saved-roundtrip fixture or a stable in-spec save/reload path.
notes: Explicitly deferred from the first dashboard tranche after live layout and propagation coverage turned green.
